copyQuestions.where: zone sheet (opened by the zone row's chevron)
copyQuestions.note: The frame draws the row's chevron but not what it opens. Built as the kit's picker grammar (SelectSheet): sheet titled 'Időzóna', the search field, every IANA zone as a radio row (place name from the zone database in English, e.g. 'Budapest', 'Buenos Aires'; offset 'GMT+2'). No new words beyond 'Keresés' / 'Nincs találat'. Localized city names do not exist on the platform and are not invented.
